name: Soundpaste
author: Marc Olivier Meunier

sections.description:
Soundpaste is a powerful WordPress plugin that enables you to convert your text content into natural-sounding audio using the ElevenLabs API. Perfect for content creators, podcasters, and website owners who want to make their content more accessible and engaging.

Key Features

  • Convert text to high-quality audio
  • Multiple voice options from ElevenLabs
  • Easy integration with WordPress posts and pages
  • Customizable audio settings
  • Responsive audio player
  • API key management for ElevenLabs
  • User-friendly interface

Use Cases

  • Create audio versions of your blog posts
  • Generate podcast content (with Soundpaste)
  • Make your content more accessible
  • Add voice narration to your website
  • Create audio content for social media

External Services

This plugin requires the use of external services to provide text-to-speech functionality. By using this plugin, you agree to the terms and privacy policies of these services.

ElevenLabs API

Service URL: https://api.elevenlabs.io
Purpose: Text-to-speech conversion using advanced AI voices
Data Sent:
– Text content from your WordPress posts
– Voice selection preferences
– API authentication key (stored locally)
When Used: When you choose to use ElevenLabs as your TTS provider and generate audio from text content
Privacy Policy: https://elevenlabs.io/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://elevenlabs.io/terms

Soundpaste Services

Service URLs:
– https://soundpaste.studio (main API)
– https://accounts.soundpaste.studio (account management)

Purpose: Advanced audio processing including:
– Text-to-speech conversion with extended voice library
– Audio file stitching and compilation
– Podcast script generation using AI
– Audio branding (intro/outro attachment)
– Enhanced audio processing capabilities

Data Sent:
– Text content from your WordPress posts
– Voice selection and audio preferences
– OAuth authentication tokens (stored locally)
– Audio files for processing and stitching
– Podcast scripts and metadata

When Used:
– When you connect your Soundpaste account via OAuth
– When generating podcasts or advanced audio compilations
– When applying branding (intro/outro) to audio files
– When using advanced voice processing features

Privacy Policy: https://soundpaste.studio/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://soundpaste.studio/terms

Data Handling

This plugin:
– Does not store personal data beyond what is necessary for functionality
– Sends only the specific text content you choose to convert to audio
– Stores API keys and OAuth tokens locally in your WordPress database
– Does not share your content with any other third parties
– Processes data according to the external services’ privacy policies

Privacy Policy

This plugin processes text content through external services (ElevenLabs and/or Soundpaste) to generate audio. For detailed information about data handling, external services used, and privacy considerations, please see the “External Services” section above.

The plugin itself:
* Does not collect or store personal user information
* Stores only necessary technical data (API keys, settings, generated audio metadata)
* Logs errors for debugging purposes when debug mode is enabled
* Processes data according to external services’ privacy policies

Additional Information

Support

For support, please:
1. Check the FAQ section above
2. Visit our support forum
3. Contact us through our website

Credits

=

  • ElevenLabs API for text-to-speech services
  • FFMpeg for file stitching
  • WordPress community for inspiration and support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the soundpaste folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings -> Soundpaste to configure your ElevenLabs API key
  4. Start creating audio content!

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.8 or higher
  • PHP 8.0 or higher
sections.faq:
Do I need an ElevenLabs API key?

You can use either ElevenLabs directly or the Soundpaste service:

ElevenLabs Direct: Requires your own API key from https://try.elevenlabs.io/ogq0axkmu98y. This gives you basic text-to-speech functionality but without advanced features like podcast generation or audio branding.

Soundpaste: Provides extended functionality including podcast generation, audio branding, and enhanced voice processing. You can start with a trial account that includes 10,000 credits for one month. Visit our website for more information about paid plans.

Why do some features require Soundpaste?

Advanced features like podcast generation and audio branding require specialized software for:
– AI-powered podcast script generation
– Audio file stitching and compilation
– Professional audio processing

These capabilities aren’t available on standard web hosting platforms. Soundpaste provides these services through our dedicated infrastructure, so you don’t need to upgrade your hosting plan or install additional software.

What data is sent to external services?

Please see the “External Services” section above for detailed information about what data is sent to ElevenLabs and Soundpaste, including links to their privacy policies and terms of service.

What if I have issues?

  1. Check the plugin settings page for any error messages
  2. Visit our support forum
  3. Contact us through our website

Contributing

We welcome contributions! Please feel free to:
* Report bugs
* Suggest features
* Submit pull requests
* Improve documentation

Credits

  • ElevenLabs API for text-to-speech services
  • WordPress community for inspiration and support
